icon.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve and logo-brand.
Edit image 3, the existing HDSL icon, into a corrected finished transparent desktop launcher icon. Images 1 and 2 are the user's PRIMARY visual references for the character identity and costume; match that whale-girl closely. Image 3 is only the composition to adapt, not the correct hair or costume.
Correct the mascot: long abundant wavy dark-blue hair falling past the shoulders on both sides, grading into soft light-blue curled ends (NOT a short bob, NOT bright turquoise hair). A white pleated/frilled maid headband following the crown, with a small blue bow on the character's left (viewer's right). One slender forward-curving blue ahoge above the head, not a giant loop. Small lateral navy whale-fin ears with pale softly scalloped undersides, matching the proportions in images 1/2; no animal/cat ears. Wide round face, large simple blue gradient eyes, tiny nose, rosy cheeks, playful happy open-mouth smile with one eye winking. Two small hands resting on the wordmark. Navy blue traditional maid dress upper body, white ruffled shoulder/bib edges, white buttoned front and a dark bow at the collar with a small pale-blue diamond center; NOT a sailor collar and NOT a school uniform. Her long curled hair must remain clearly visible at both sides even in this bust icon. A small section of her navy whale tail may curve up behind one side. Keep everything wholesome and fully clothed.
At the FRONT LOWER THIRD, exactly the word "HDSL", four uppercase letters H, D, S, L, in that order. Typography is the key correction: HARD, SOLID, ANGULAR BLOCK LETTERS, thick straight strokes, square corners with small cut/chamfered bevels, squared D bowl and angular S, visually sturdy like an angular voxel-game launcher wordmark. Flat upright baseline, white faces, dark navy outline, restrained steel-blue extruded edge. Absolutely no rounded bubble letters, no pill-shaped terminals, no rubber or inflated 3D look. The word must be readable at desktop icon size.
Clean polished chibi anime cel shading faithful to images 1 and 2, simple strong outline, not hyper-rendered, no excessive glossy eye highlights. Square balanced single icon with all hair, fins and lettering comfortably inside the canvas.
Completely remove all captions, speech marks, decorative stars, question marks, emoticons and 'Ciallo' from the references. Only text anywhere is HDSL. True transparent background with clean alpha, no rectangle, no checkerboard, no mockup.
